_comment: Ready-made diffuse-scattering tables for the CIR-Generator's Sionna Ray
Tracing model ('Material Scattering (S / xpd per material)'). Selecting
several presets merges them left to right, so a wide '*' entry can be
laid down first and individual materials corrected on top of it.
A table maps a radio-material name to either a plain scattering
coefficient S or the full entry {s, xpd, pattern, alpha_r}. The key '*'
applies to every material the scene carries and is overridden by an
explicit entry. Material names are the scene's own: sionna's munich
carries brick/concrete/marble/metal/wood, and scenes written by
pages/osm_scene add asphalt, foliage, water, sea_water, roof_tiles and
the ground types. Patterns: lambertian, directive (alpha_r), backscattering.
Cached CIRs key on the preset NAME, not on these numbers: after editing
a table in place, tick 'Reset Cache' once (or add a new preset instead).

presets.name: none
presets.label: None — scene as loaded (S = 0)
presets.description: Specular only. Every material Sionna ships carries scattering_coefficient = 0, so this is what a scene looks like untouched.

presets.name: uniform_weak
presets.label: Uniform weak — S = 0.2, lambertian
presets.description: Smooth facades. Lower end of the 1-10 GHz measurements of building walls.

presets.name: uniform_moderate
presets.label: Uniform moderate — S = 0.4, lambertian
presets.description: Typical mixed urban surfaces; a reasonable default when the scene's materials are not known individually.

presets.name: uniform_strong
presets.label: Uniform strong — S = 0.6, lambertian
presets.description: Rough / ornamented surfaces. Upper bound: most of the incident power leaves the surface diffusely.

presets.name: urban_directive
presets.label: Urban directive — S = 0.4, directive (alpha_r = 5)
presets.description: Same strength as uniform_moderate but with the lobe around the specular direction that measurements of building walls actually show.

presets.name: urban_backscatter
presets.label: Urban backscatter — S = 0.4, backscattering (alpha_r = 4)
presets.description: For geometries where TX and RX look at the same wall from nearly the same side.

presets.name: building_materials
presets.label: Per material — buildings (concrete / brick / marble / wood / metal / glass)
presets.description: Per-material strengths for the five materials sionna's munich scene carries, plus glass. Metal and glass are smooth and scatter little; brick and plaster-finished concrete scatter most.

presets.name: osm_outdoor
presets.label: Per material — OSM outdoor surfaces (asphalt / foliage / water / tiles / ground)
presets.description: The extra materials pages/osm_scene writes. Foliage is a volume of leaves and scatters almost everything it does not absorb; water is a mirror.
